	<script type="text/javascript">
	
	jQuery(document).ready(function(){
			 /*	This method shifts the site structure from "left to right" mode to "right to left" for Arabic.*/
		    var textDir = 'ltr';
		    if(textDir == 'rtl'){
		    	jQuery('html').attr('dir','rtl');
		    	jQuery('h3').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('h2').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('.intro').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('#devices').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('#send-temporary-security-code-to').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('.recovery').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('#rkLink').addClass('fltR');
		    	jQuery('.popUpDescText').addClass('fltR');
		    	jQuery('.popUpDescText').css({'text-align':'right'});
		    	jQuery('.close').text('');
		    	jQuery('#countdown').css({'margin-right':'22px'});
		    	jQuery('.backtoschool.edit .formrow').css({'margin-right':'-4px'});
		    	jQuery(jQuery('img')[2]).css({'padding-left':'8px'});
		    	jQuery('#AreUStillThrDescription').css({'direction':'rtl','text-align':'right'});
				jQuery('#label9').css({'padding-top':'7px'});
		    	jQuery('#label4').css({'padding-top':'3px'});
		    	jQuery('#recoveryKeyInputHeading').css({'text-align':'center'});
		    	jQuery('.buttons').css({'float': 'left'});
		    	jQuery('.logo h2').css({'float': 'right'});
		    	jQuery('#rkOverlayPanel #bot-nav .send-code').css({'float': 'right', 'position': 'relative'});
		    	jQuery('#rkOverlayPanel .recovery-key').css({'text-align' : 'center', 'text-indent' : '0'});
		    	 }
		});
	</script>


	<script type="text/javascript">
	jQuery.noConflict();
	(function( $ ) {
	jQuery(document).ready(function(){	
		$('#bot-nav-panel').wrap('<div class="button-panel">');
		$('.button-panel').prepend('<hr>');
		$('#rkLink').wrap('<div class="recovery">');
		$('#refresh_device_div').css({'display':'block'});
		
		var textDir = 'ltr';
	    if(textDir == 'rtl'){
	    	jQuery('div.button-panel').css({'width':'500px'});
	    	jQuery('#bot-nav-panel').css({'padding-right':'300px'});
	    }
		
	});
	})(jQuery);
	</script>

<aside id="ac-gn-segmentbar" class="ac-gn-segmentbar" lang="en-US" dir="ltr" data-strings="{ 'exit': 'Exit', 'view': '{%STOREFRONT%} Store Home', 'segments': { 'smb': 'Business Store Home', 'eduInd': 'Education Store Home', 'other': 'Store Home' } }">

	<div class="ac-gn-content">
		<ul class="ac-gn-header">
			<li class="ac-gn-item ac-gn-menuicon">
